labels.notes: Caller traces resolve to HtmlPopupScreenKt / ReleaseNotesKt — both internal Compose screens. htmlContentPath origin is internal asset path, not Intent extra. setAllowFileAccess(true) is a hardening concern but no LFI exploit chain visible. **Stage 2.b deep-link verification (2026-04-30) — FP CONFIRMED**: AndroidManifest.xml grep for 'android:scheme'/'android:host'/'deepLink' = 0 matches. Only exported entry is VehicleControlActivity with action-based intent-filters; no URI-data filters. HtmlPopupScreen / ReleaseNotes are not Compose Nav routes registered for external entry. htmlContentPath origin = ReleaseInfoData.summaryPath/whatsNewPath/detailedDescriptionPath, populated from OTA update flow (UpdateBroadcastReceiver exported=false, action ai.ftdot.update.UPDATE_STATE_CHANGED) — external-app uncontrolled.

Same caller chain as vc-1. loadUrl(htmlContentPath) is fed by internal callers. **Stage 2.b deep-link verification (2026-04-30) — FP CONFIRMED**: Same evidence as vc-1. No URI deep-link in manifest, htmlContentPath flows from OTA-trusted ReleaseInfoData.

Caller chain: ApplicationDetailsScreenKt UI → ApplicationDetailsViewModel.grantPermission → AppPermissionManager. packageName is supplied via SavedStateHandle (Navigation Component arg). **Stage 2.b deep-link verification (2026-04-30) — FP CONFIRMED**: (1) ApplicationDetails Nav route = 'application_details_route/{app_package_name}' — registered in NavGraphBuilder only, no manifest URI deep-link. (2) NestedNavRouter binding map has no APPLICATIONS key — only VehicleInformationNavRouter + ConvenienceNavRouter implement NavRouter. (3) IntentRouter NAVIGATE_TO_SETTING action builds path via LinkProvider.createLink which produces single-segment path + query (categoryKey?section=subKey); Uri.pathSegments.size > 1 condition never satisfied → subPathRoute(NestedNavRouter.findRoute) never called for any external intent. External NAVIGATE_TO_SETTING reaches ApplicationsScreen (CategoryType.APPLICATIONS.route='applications') at most — not ApplicationDetails. packageName fundamentally external-app uncontrolled.

Symmetric to vc-3. Same caller chain, same FP verdict. **Stage 2.b deep-link verification (2026-04-30) — FP CONFIRMED**: Same NestedNavRouter / IntentRouter / single-segment categoryPath evidence as vc-3.

Producer = IntentRouter.toNavigationEvent. IntentRouter receives external Intent (action 'ai.umos.vehiclecontrol.NAVIGATE_TO_SETTING') via VehicleControlActivity (exported=true) and broadcasts the response payload. Implicit broadcast confirmed → TP. Severity stays medium because the response payload is currently 'success'/'fail' status strings, not user data — but the channel exists.

Manifest confirms <receiver android:exported="true"> with no permission gate. macAddress Intent extra is persisted to PairedDeviceRepository.insertDevice without validation. system-context-adjacent (preferences DB) → severity raised to high.
TP as a hardening concern. registerReceiver flag suppression is real and propagates to all callers, but each caller currently uses internal action names. Keep at LOW.

B-3.c resolved (2026-04-29): caller is SyncConfigsProvider:83 with `new ConfigLoader(BuildConfig.IDENTIFIER, BuildConfig.SERVER_PUBLIC_KEY)`. passPhrase is a build-time constant — same key on every device. APK reverse engineering recovers BuildConfig → identical private key → decrypt every device's encryptedYaml config. Severity raised to HIGH.

B-3.c CONFIRMED (2026-04-29): SysLogService.java:170 emits `Log.d(SysLogService.TAG, "onTokenChange : " + this.$authData)`. Token reaches logcat on every token rotation. logcat is readable by READ_LOGS / dumpsys / vendor diagnostics. Stage 3 attacker perspective also confirms — strong TP 3/3.

B-3.c PROVISIONAL (2026-04-29): grep across `ai/pleos/sync/**` for CertificatePinner|TrustManager|HostnameVerifier|setSSLSocketFactory|sslContext|network_security_config = NO MATCHES. sync 패키지 자체엔 pinning 코드 없음. Caveat: third-party HTTP/gRPC libs (com.squareup.okhttp3 등) 추가 grep 후 최종 결정 — 일단 TP, severity MEDIUM 유지. 추가 grep: 앱 코드(ai/pleos/sync/**)에 .certificatePinner / setSSLSocketFactory / .sslSocketFactory 호출 0건 — sync 패키지 내 pinning 부재 confirmed. CCGAuthenticator의 HttpClient 구현(별도 inner class) 내 SSL 호출은 후속 follow-up.

Manifest <provider exported="true"> + query() returns assets/prompts.json verbatim. Confirmed TP. The LLM system-prompt corpus exposed to any installed app is a clear prompt-injection / jailbreak surface.
Confirmed TP. Manifest <receiver exported="true"> with no permission attribute, custom action handler that triggers file delete + Process.killProcess. DoS primitive against the on-device LLM.

Discovered during B-3.c. Same pattern as ssl-2 but for driver PII (UUID, birthdate, email, name). Kotlin data-class toString() embeds all four fields verbatim. If any caller logs HmgUserInfo, full identity reaches logcat. Severity HIGH (PII + privacy regulation impact). 추가 grep: (Timber|Log.[diwev]) + (HmgUserInfo|hmgUserInfo) 매치 0건 — leak primitive는 real이지만 실 emission 미확인. Stage 3 attacker abstain → 2/3 TP.

Discovered during B-3.c root-causing of ssl-1. BuildConfig.IDENTIFIER is a build-time constant baked into the APK and used as KDF passphrase. APK reverse engineering recovers it — effectively a hardcoded secret. Independent finding (separate from ssl-1 KDF concern).

B-3.c 추가 grep (2026-04-29) 결과: SysLogService.java:76 'ManagedChannelBuilder.forTarget(BuildConfig.LOGCAT_PROXY_SERVER_URL).usePlaintext().build()' — TLS 명시적 off, 차량 syslog가 평문 gRPC로 외부 송출. MITM이 systemID + 진단 페이로드를 평문 관찰 가능. severity HIGH 격상. (2026-04-30 line 정정: GT 120 → 76 보고서 정합 맞춤)
